claims: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is a newly launched Delaware-based closed-end investment company.
Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is managed by Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P. (PSCM).
Bill Ackman is a key figure in the management of Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS).
Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) aims to provide a permanent capital model for investing in large-cap, North American-headquartered companies.
Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is planning a combined IPO of PSUS shares and Pershing Square Inc. (PSI) in 2026.
The combined IPO of PSUS shares and Pershing Square Inc. (PSI) aims to raise up to $10 billion.
As of April 2026, PSUS is conducting a dual IPO.
PSUS plans to list on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "PSUS".
Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) is designed to be a listed closed-end fund.
Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS) aims to emulate a "Berkshire Hathaway-style" permanent capital structure to reduce redemption risks.
